patch_description: Replace the empty stub with a deterministic optimization: structured initialization inside the unit equilateral triangle, followed by a greedy random-restart local search that repeatedly identifies the worst (minimum-area) point triplet and perturbs its vertices to raise the global minimum triangle area. All points are projected back into the triangle (barycentric clipping). A fixed seed guarantees reproducibility, and the best configuration found across restarts is returned. This directly maximizes the primary metric (min_area_normalized) while keeping runtime modest via a capped iteration budget and vectorized area computation over all C(11,3)=165 triplets.
